articles.title: Ravens, Orioles back-to-back games to cause heavy traffic, road closures
articles.description: Downtown Baltimore will see road closures and heavy traffic Sunday as the Ravens and Orioles play home games hours apart.

articles.title: Orioles’ Baz avoids fracture from 105 mph comebacker to elbow: ‘I’ll be OK’
articles.description: A 105.1 mph line drive by the Mets’ Bo Bichette hit Orioles right-hander Shane Baz in the elbow and he left the game after one warmup pitch.

articles.title: Pete Alonso haunts Mets again as Orioles stay alive with 7-1 win
articles.description: Pete Alonso launched one of the Orioles’ four home runs Wednesday to pull off a sweep of the New York Mets, his former team.

articles.title: Orioles place Jackson Holliday on IL with time running out on season
articles.description: Manager Craig Albernaz said Wednesday afternoon that Orioles second baseman Jackson Holliday was “banged up.” Now he hits the IL.

articles.title: Orioles’ Honeycutt, Irish among prospects headed to Arizona Fall League
articles.description: The Orioles are sending eight prospects to the Arizona Fall League including first-round picks OF Vance Honeycutt and 1B/OF Ike Irish.

articles.title: Orioles too-early offseason preview: 8 biggest questions facing Mike Elias
articles.description: Last winter was billed as one of the most important in recent franchise history, but this upcoming offseason might be even more pivotal for the Orioles and owner David Rubenstein.

articles.title: Orioles ride another big inning to beat Blue Jays, 7-4, stay alive in race
articles.description: The Orioles’ offense didn’t waste any time against Max Scherzer, and Chris Bassitt delivered a strong start against his former team in a needed win.

articles.title: Orioles place Kyle Bradish on IL, ending pitcher’s regular season
articles.description: After Saturday’s loss to the Blue Jays, Orioles manager Craig Albernaz was asked if the ballclub had considered shutting starting pitcher Kyle Bradish down because of his climbing innings total.

articles.title: Orioles’ playoff hopes slipping away after 8-1 loss to Blue Jays
articles.description: The Orioles have only 12 games remaining, and they’ll have to win almost all of them to earn the right to play in October.
